_: How to watch a network from Cancún, for the live game block (app.js renderTeamLive). Keys are regexes matched against the broadcast names a game carries (ESPN's, or channels.json clubs), case-insensitive; first match wins. The US template rows were replaced 2026-10-31. ota = the Cancún over-the-air station and its virtual channel (Mexico's virtual numbers are national; call signs from Wikipedia's list of Quintana Roo stations, which cites the IFT); stream = the services that carry it in Mexico (ViX for TUDN, Disney+ for ESPN). No pay-TV numbers: app.js prints only ota, DirecTV and Xfinity, and Cancún's providers (Izzi, Sky México, Totalplay, Megacable) have no field yet — a cable-only network (AYM Sports, Fox Sports, ESPN) shows as a plain name, or under Streaming when it has a stream list. Neither ESPN's mex.2 feed nor the LMB's statsapi schedule names broadcasters (checked 2026-10-31), so these rows only fire through clubs or future listings. A streaming-only service lists just its name.

channels.note: the LMB's free-to-air partner from June 2026 (three seasons, Excélsior 2026-06-06)

links._: Where each name in the strip goes (app.js buildWatchList links an entry to the longest name it contains).

_hide: An entry with hide: true is a feed no Cancún viewer can use (Canadian regional and national feeds from the template): the strip leaves it out.

clubs._: What every game of a club carries beyond the league's listing (app.js buildWatchStrip adds them when the game's own list lacks them). Empty for Cancún: in the Apertura 2026 Cancún FC's Liga de Expansión games air mostly on AYM Sports (a pay-TV channel; Mediotiempo's jornada 7 list, 2026-09-02), some Expansión games on ESPN; the LMB is on ESPN / Disney+, Fox Sports and from June 2026 Imagen TV — none confirmed per Tigres game, so nothing is added to every game yet.
